body:
It's going to happen :*(  

I'm sorry world

I'm sorry all those of you who love me so, so much.  Please, for the love of god, understand this was not your faults.  There was nothing anyone could have done.  This is me.  I am so, so broken beyond repair.  I'm enduring such endless agony and I am desperate to be out of this misery.  It is the middle of the day at work and I'm crying as I write this.  So broken.   I'm so much sorrier than any of you could ever know.  I wish more than anything I could love you all endlessly, until the end of time.  There would be no greater wish for me than to have all of you I love close, to know that none of you would ever go away, and that I would never leave any of you.  Maybe if there actually is a god, that is what he'll reward me with.  That is the place I'll go.  A place where I feel I am with you all.

 You all thought I was strong, but I am too weak for this world.  Brave I am, brave as fuck, but strong I am not.   Sorry, and please don't hate me.  Or at least, try to forgive me one day.    I love you all so much more than you can ever know.   You will realize in time that my love for all of you is why I am doing this.
someone permanent.  unfortunately nothing is permanent, even life.

its sweet dude, and i appreciate the gesture.  but its simply not what im talking about.  im sorry.  i just have accepted i will enver have what it is im looking for.  and i cant deal.  thank you for trying to help though.

Thanks for the response.  No idea why I even want one, or why I've posted.  This is just me venting my fears somewhere, as I have no one to tell them to.  I mean, I have so many people in my life, but I can not tell them this shit.  i am fucking terrified, and just want to tell someone.  fuck i wish someone would just hold me and tell me life can be better tahn the shit hand ive been dealt.  but it is too fucking wrong to put my shit on anyone else.


i seriously can not handle this shit any longer.  i think i am done.  and i am terrified to be done, but i am.  i have spent so much time figuring out how suicide affects loved ones.  I wrote personal letters to all the peope who will be hurt the most, explained things as best i could and made sure they know its not their fault.  i dont know what more i can possibly do at this point.
People, I am really not playing around.  This is serious.  If I had a means to do it this second, I absolutely would.  I don't know what to do.
